fieldSemantics.methodCode: RRP controlled method reference resolved from CanonicalMethodProjection
fieldSemantics.methodVersion: Upstream method version; RRP may not rewrite it
fieldSemantics.calculationDigest: Governed upstream calculation digest when supplied; null requires explicit limitation and must never be synthesized from raw Core output
fieldSemantics.projection: CanonicalMethodProjection only; no raw Core schema
fieldSemantics.unknowns: Union of upstream explicit unknown disclosures and RRP admission unknowns without deletion
fieldSemantics.limitations: Bound-scope, policy, availability and evidence limitations
